ne9f8bf371a.headline: Back in the red: Aus shares 0.13% lower at noon
ne9f8bf371a.summary: Australian shares fell 0.13% at midday, with Lucapa Diamond Company and partners announcing an $8 million combined distribution and capital payment.
ne9f8bf371a.why: Lucapa Diamond is a notable Australian mining company; its capital distribution and market moves reflect investor sentiment in the Australian resource sector.

n7776cf2f4b.headline: Commodity prices: China records its first trade deficit in three years
n7776cf2f4b.summary: China imported more goods than it exported in February, its first trade deficit in three years, according to the report. Observers attribute the shortfall mainly to sharply higher commodity prices.
n7776cf2f4b.why: China's trade balance is a closely watched gauge of global demand and of the health of the world's second-largest economy. Commodity import costs feed into its trade figures.
n7776cf2f4b.why_moved: The unexpected deficit reverses a long run of surpluses, and observers link it to higher commodity import costs.
